AGENDA
PLANNING COMMISSION
MEETING
Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at (310) 378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
Any person who has made campaign contributions to any of the members of the Planning Commission within twelve months before this meeting, should examine the provisions of Government Code Section 84308 which is posted on the bulletin board outside the Council Chamber.
We are advised by the members of the Commission that none of them have received campaign contributions within the last twelve months.
The applicant or any property owner entitled to notice of the hearing may, within fifteen days after the date of the Planning Commission decision, appeal the Planning Commission decision to the City Council (Ord. No. 091-529). A fee is required for filing an appeal with the City Clerkâ€™s office (R05-14).
The Council may, within fifteen days after the date of the decision or on or before the first date following the first Council meeting after the date of the Planning Commission decision, whichever occurs last: 1) Confirm the action of the Planning Commission and grant or deny the application; 2) Set the matter for public hearing and dispose of it in the same manner as on an appeal; or 3) Amend, modify, delete or add any condition of approval which the Council finds is not substantial under the circumstances relative to or affecting the property subject to the application for a development entitlement. Any determination of the Council pursuant to this paragraph shall be conclusive and final.
The Planning Commission reserves the right to modify the order of items shown on the agenda and advises all interested parties to arrive promptly at the commencement of the meeting.
THIS AGENDA HAS BEEN AMENDED TO INCLUDE THE FOLLOWING NOTICE: This meeting is being held pursuant to Executive Order N-25-20 issued by California Governor Gavin Newsom on March 12, 2020 to further the State's efforts to control the spread of COVID-19 Coronavirus. Any and all Planning Commissioners may attend and participate by teleconference/virtual meeting. Members of the public may also attend by teleconference in order to observe and provide public comment during the meeting. The meeting will not be livestreamed. If you wish to participate, the following process must be followed. The meeting will begin promptly at 6:30 p.m. so please prepare and join the meeting in advance of 6:30 p.m. The Zoom Meeting ID is 813 1571 7780 (direct link: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/81315717780

Per the California Government Code Section 54954.2, the Planning Commission is prohibited from discussing or taking immediate action on any item not on the agenda unless it can be demonstrated that the item is of an emergency nature, or the need to take action arose subsequent to the posting of the agenda.

  PLANNING COMMISSION
  JULY 21, 2020

City Hall  July 21, 2020
340 Palos Verdes Drive West  6:30 p.m.
Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL

Present:  Wade, Roos, Walker, Lazarro, Criley
Absent:  None
Also present: Acting Planning & Building Director Brianna Rindge, Planner Maddie Bright, Assistant
  City Attorney John Cotti

COMMUNICATIONS FROM PUBLIC

  Speakers: None

CONSENT CALENDAR

2.  M-1388-20 (RESOLUTION NO. PCR-2020-1184); Consideration of a  Miscellaneous
  Application for an accessory structure exceeding 8’ at the single-family residence located at 2848
  Via Victoria. Lot 7, Block 2343, Tract 7332. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to
  California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.

  Applicant: Richard Gastelum, 2906 Perkins Ln, Redondo Beach, CA 90278
  Owner: Charles Leatherbury

  Action: Criley moved and Wade seconded to approve the application (5-0 in favor) with standard
  conditions.

3.  NC-1676/M-1390-20 (RESOLUTION NO. PCR-2020-1182); Consideration of Neighborhood
  Compatibility and Miscellaneous Applications for a new single-family residence located at 516
  Avenida Mirola. Lots 1 & part of 2, Block 2222, Tract 6888. This project is exempt from CEQA
  pursuant to California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.

  Applicant: Pritzkat & Johnson Architects, Inc, 306 Vista Del Mar Suite A, Redondo Beach, CA
  90277
  Owner: Dave & Marcia Streeter

  Action: Criley moved and Wade seconded to approve the application (5-0 in favor) with standard
  conditions and the following conditions: 1) Roof and surface flow runoff from the project site shall
  be minimized by directing runoff through to vegetated areas before discharge; 2) The existing location,
  alignment, and condition of the sewer mainline, shall be determined and confirmed by video

   surveillance and report, and the easement shall be shown on the plan; 3) No structures and/or
  hardscaping shall be constructed within the easements on the property; and 4) Hollywood Berm shall
  be constructed, per City standards, and determined by the City Engineer.

6.  M-1368-20 (RESOLUTION NO. PCR-2020-1181); Consideration of a  Miscellaneous
  Application for an accessory structure exceeding 8’ at the single-family residence located at 2508
  Novato Place. Lot 17, Block 1750, Tract 8652. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to
  California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.

  Applicant: Christopher Sisto, 10900 Wilshire Blvd #1200, Los Angeles, CA 90024

  Action: Criley moved and Wade seconded to approve the application (5-0 in favor) with standard
  conditions.

OLD BUSINESS

4.  NC-1668/G-1635/M-1386/SC-140-19 (RESOLUTION NO. PCR-2020-1173); Consideration of
  Neighborhood Compatibility, Grading, Miscellaneous & Sports Court Applications for a new
  single-family residence located at 2014 Via Cerritos. Lot 3, Block 5, Tract 8043. This project is
  exempt from CEQA pursuant to California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.

  Applicant: Luis de Moraes, Envirotechno Architecture, 116 S. Catalina Ave #102, Redondo Beach,
  CA 90277
  Owner: Varsha Patel

  Speakers: Steve Shimoyama, Eric Cheng

  Action: Lazzaro moved and Criley seconded to approve the application (5-0 in favor) with standard
  conditions and the following conditions: 1) There appears to be an existing sewer easement on the
  property. The developer shall determine the actual location, alignment, and condition of the sewer
  mainline, confirmed by video surveillance and report. Easements shall be shown on the plan. No
  object, whether a permanent structure, or a temporary structure, or any object which is difficult to
  remove is allowed within the sewer easements. Any grading within the sewer easement shall be
  approved prior to issuance of building permits; 2) The project shall be subject to compliance with
  the municipal National Pollutant Discharge Elimination System (NPDES) permit. The project shall
  implement mitigation measures to protect slopes and provide storm drain system and stenciling.
  Roof and surface flow runoff from the project site shall be minimized by controlling runoff through
  infiltration to vegetated areas before discharge, bio-retention, and/or rainfall harvest and use. The
  project runoff shall follow the course of the natural slope and shall not be diverted in the opposite
  direction. Prior to issuance of final approval for the project construction, proof of compliance shall
  be provided to the Engineering Department; 3) The new walkway shall be constructed per City
  standard. The first 5 feet of the walkway, from edge of pavement towards the property line, shall be
  constructed at a slope no greater than 2.0%; 4) All second story ridge heights shall be reduced 1’
  lower than shown on the approved plans; 5) The bedroom chimney shall be completely removed; 6)
  Any fence fronting Via Cerritos shall be pulled 5’ down slope from where it is shown on the
  approved plans and the fence shall be no higher than 6.5’ from the lower of natural or existing grade;
  and 7) Any vegetation planted along the fence line fronting Via Cerritos shall not exceed the adjacent
  fence elevation.

Action Minutes  Page 2 of 4
July 21, 2020 Planning Commission Meeting  City of Palos Verdes Estates
 NEW BUSINESS

1.  M-1390/G-1642-20 (RESOLUTION NO. PCR-2020-1185); Consideration of Miscellaneous and
  Grading Applications for renovations including walls exceeding 8’ at the single-family residence
  located at 1425 Via Zumaya. Lot 67, Tract 27438. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant
  to California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.

  Applicant: Thomas Dobos, 7307 Ansel, Irvine, CA 92618
  Owner: Ross & Peggy Shuster

  Speakers: Harry Bruni

  Action: Continued.

5.  NC-1676/G-1641-20 (RESOLUTION NO. PCR-2020-1183); Consideration of Neighborhood
  Compatibility and Grading Applications for additions and remodeling to an existing single-family
  residence located at 2305 Via Acalones. Lot 16, Block 1638, Tract 7330. This project is exempt
  from CEQA pursuant to California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.

  Applicant: Jacky Sbarounis, JMS Designs, 804 Faysmith Ave, Torrance, CA 90503
  Owner: Mr. & Mrs. John Aguirre

  Speakers: Tony Ramos, Burt Walker, Edward Barad

  Action: Wade moved and Criley seconded to approve the application (5-0 in favor) with standard
  conditions and the following conditions: 1) The existing mature Brazilian Pepper tree in the front
  yard of the property shall be removed subject to the concurrence of the Palos Verdes Homes
  Association; 2) Street improvement plans, separate from the grading and drainage plans, for curb
  and gutter shall be prepared by a registered engineer. Street width shall be 30 feet measured from
  the curb on the opposite side of the street. The curb on the opposite side of the street shall be shown
  on the plans. Plans shall be reviewed and approved by the City; 3) The driveway shall be constructed
  per City standards; 4) The existing non-standard encroachments shall be removed from the right-of-
  way; and 5) The gable for the main/family room area on the north side of the home shall be revised
  to be consistent with the roof gables on the remainder of the façade (no more than 2’ from the edge
  of the fascia board).

ITEMS OF INFORMATION

13.  Administrative Approvals – Reviewed and filed.

14.  Art Jury Meeting Schedule – Reviewed and filed.

ACTION MINUTES

15.  Meeting of June 16, 2020.

  Action: Lazzaro moved and Criley seconded to add to the fourth condition added to the approval
  of 2321 Via Acalones a quote from the exact motion (“implying a drop of the floors themselves in
  the base”) resulting in the following condition in full: “The height of each ridge shall be reduced 4’
